svg.title: Morning sessions: make the word rise through its arrangement
svg.desc: Only the last three letter baselines move upward in 36-unit steps. Letter sizes, weights, horizontal positions, copy, photography and supporting information remain fixed. Original fictional design. Photographs previously generated with AI and reused unchanged; expressive typography composed separately with a fixed variable-font weight.
svg.text: AFTER · The word rises across the page
Only the declared expressive intervention changes. Essential information stays readable and fixed.
